_doc: Dataset registry (docs/DATASET_EXPANSION_2026.md). Evidence levels: E1 = official publisher text read directly; E1-m = mirror; E2 = secondary/search; E3 = none. Only E1 may support COMMERCIAL_*. 'public' is never a licence. No dataset was downloaded.

datasets.version: MLS v1 (OpenSLR SLR94, English). Statistics and licence from the publisher's HF card facebook/multilingual_librispeech (last updated 2024-08-12).
datasets.hours_evidence: E1 publisher card 'Data Statistics': train 44,659.74 h + dev 15.75 h + test 15.55 h = 44,691.04 h. 44,660 h = train only (rounded); 44,691 h = all splits.
datasets.speakers_evidence: E1 publisher card '# Speakers': train 5,490 (2,742 M / 2,748 F), dev 42, test 42. 5,574 = sum of the per-split counts (MLS splits are speaker-disjoint by design; to verify on download). 5,490 = train only.
datasets.provenance: LibriVox public-domain audiobook recordings, segmented/aligned by Meta AI (publisher)
datasets.download_url: https://www.openslr.org/94/ (official distributor; egress-blocked here). NOTE: the publisher HF repo facebook/multilingual_librispeech does NOT contain English (configs: dutch, french, german, italian, polish, portuguese, spanish only). Mirror parler-tts/mls_eng (E1-m): train 10.8M rows, 704.7 GB parquet, dev 3.8K, test 3.8K rows.
datasets.sha256: NOT_AVAILABLE: official English archive not reachable from this environment; no download manifest hash can be produced. Required before GO (readiness.json mls_download_provenance_verified).
